subject: SCI
title: (Demo) Water and solutions
source: Demo data written for testing, not EDB text. Build real units from the official PDF with scripts/extract_curriculum.py.

objectives.text: Describe the three states of water and the changes between them, including melting, freezing, evaporation, boiling and condensation.
Use the particle model to explain changes of state: particles move faster and the spaces between them change, but the particles themselves do not change in size.
Recognise solutions, solutes and solvents, and state that water is a common solvent.
Separate mixtures by filtration, evaporation and distillation, and state when each method is suitable.
Follow laboratory safety rules, such as wearing safety goggles when heating.
